summary: Wave 3 Pre-Launch Increment B backend verified. Created /app/backend/tests/test_wave3_prelaunch_B_international_routes.py with 15 tests covering GET /api/geo/markets (16 markets, GB-only pricing_configured=true), GET /api/geo/autocomplete (short-query + no-Google-key manual fallback, public), GET /api/quote/estimate (UK->UK domestic priced, GB->IE international requires_manual_review with 'United Kingdom' + 'Republic of Ireland' in message, FR->FR domestic_other requires review, legacy no-country-code defaults to domestic_uk with price, CN dropoff unsupported requires review, requires_auth), and POST /api/jobs (UK-only -> status=posted/route_class=domestic_uk; GB->IE with all new address fields -> status=awaiting_manual_quote/route_class=international with pickup_postcode/country/country_code/place_id and dropoff_* all round-tripping via GET /api/jobs/{id}). All 15 new tests pass. Regression: all 41 pre-existing tests in test_wave3_phaseB_search_and_driver_dashboard.py (19) + test_wave3_prelaunch_A_driver_verification.py (22) still pass. Total 56/56.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2298 geo_autocomplete correctly treats both empty and 'placeholder…' Google keys as unconfigured -> returns {suggestions:[], source:'manual'}. Public — no auth dependency. Good.

server.py:744-748 quote_estimate preserves legacy contract: when neither country code is supplied, route_class is forced to 'domestic_uk' regardless of what classify_route would have said (which returns 'unsupported' for empty codes). Prevents silent breakage of existing UK clients.
server.py:686-692 create_job mirrors the same legacy-fallback logic, so UK-only POST /api/jobs bodies continue to persist with status='posted' and route_class='domestic_uk'.

server.py:707-710 status/suggested_price gating is coupled to route_class == 'domestic_uk' — international/domestic_other/unsupported all correctly persist as 'awaiting_manual_quote' with suggested_price=null.

server.py:313 public_job returns all extra keys from the stored doc (only strips _id, and pickup_/dropoff_address when not private), so the new pickup_postcode/pickup_country/pickup_country_code/pickup_place_id (and dropoff_*) fields automatically round-trip via GET /api/jobs/{id} without any schema changes. Confirmed by test.
server.py:2287 geo_markets returns the raw SUPPORTED_MARKETS list — matches spec (16 entries, GB pricing_configured=true, all others false).
markets.classify_route correctly handles unsupported ISO2 (e.g. 'CN') by returning 'unsupported', which flows through to requires_manual_review=true.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed jobs are created by TestJobsIntlAddressing (one UK-only, one GB->IE). Both persist in db.jobs and are not cleaned up because the app has no delete-job endpoint for customers; this matches the pattern used by prior wave3 test suites. All test jobs are prefixed with 'TEST_intl_' in their title for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env is empty string, which makes /api/geo/autocomplete return source='manual' for all real queries. If a future increment configures a real key, the autocomplete tests here will still pass (they only assert on the short-query and no-key branches) but a new test should be added to exercise the Google path with a mock. Also: TestJobsIntlAddressing does not clean up its two test jobs (no customer-delete endpoint exists); consider adding a fixture that queries and marks them once such an endpoint lands.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. All Increment B endpoints behave per spec and legacy UK contract is preserved.
